_meta.source: 漫剧创作库/docs/vfx-design-standard.md + atmosphere-interaction-standard.md + environmental-destruction-standard.md + action-vocabulary.md
_meta.description: 视觉特效词库：光源绑定、热畸变、余韵残留、材质破坏、环境联动
_meta.usage: Seedance/MJ 提示词中特效相关词汇的权威参考，按物理规律分类

interactive_lighting.description: 光源绑定法则：任何发光特效必须对周围产生真实光照反射

categories.name: 面部光照反馈
prompts: casting harsh blue light on the character's face
warm firelight flickering across facial features
green energy glow reflecting in the character's pupils
purple magic illuminating one side of the face, deep shadows on the other
golden aura casting soft upward light under the chin

categories.name: 材质光照反馈
prompts: blue energy sphere reflecting cold metallic sheen on armor
fire magic scorching the ground with orange-red glow
lightning casting sharp white highlights on wet surfaces
spiritual energy making jade accessories glow translucent
dark energy corroding nearby stone surfaces with purple-black veins

categories.name: 环境光照反馈
prompts: energy blast illuminating surrounding fog from within
magic circle light casting long shadows across the floor
explosion lighting up entire corridor in flash of orange
spiritual aura making dust particles glow like fireflies
power surge causing nearby lights to flicker and shatter

heat_distortion.description: 热畸变与介质扭曲：高温/高能法术周围空气的物理形变

categories.name: 空气折射
prompts: intense heat distortion blurring the background behind the fire
shimmering air around the concentrated energy sphere
thermal haze warping the visible space around the character
superheated air causing visible heat ripples above the impact point
reality itself seems to bend and warp around the gathering power

categories.name: 冲击波
prompts: invisible shockwave kicking up a ring of dust from the ground
concentric shockwave rippling outward through rain drops
pressure wave causing nearby debris to fly outward
air displacement blowing hair and clothes outward from impact
shockwave visibly distorting the air in an expanding sphere

categories.name: 能量尾迹
prompts: trailing arcs of electricity following hand movement
fading afterimage of light along the weapon's swing path
energy particles streaming behind the charging character
glowing residue left on surfaces the energy touched
fading light trail marking the path of the projectile

lingering_aftermath.description: 生命周期的余韵：特效必须有始、中、终，严禁瞬间抹除

categories.name: 余烬与火花
prompts: drifting glowing embers floating upward from the scorched ground
shower of bright orange sparks erupting from metal-on-metal impact
tiny floating particles of residual energy slowly fading
scattered sparks dancing in the air before extinguishing
embers swirling in the updraft created by the blast

categories.name: 硝烟与粉尘
prompts: lingering thick smoke slowly rising from the impact crater
billowing cloud of grey dust settling gradually
wisps of dark smoke curling from the charred remains
fine ash particles drifting through the air like snow
lingering haze obscuring the aftermath, slowly clearing

categories.name: 环境疤痕
prompts: scorched earth with glowing red cracks still radiating heat
deep crater with molten edges slowly cooling to black
spiderweb cracks spreading across the stone surface, some still faintly glowing
shattered ground with exposed glowing energy veins beneath
permanent scorch marks on walls and floor from the energy blast

special_effects_types.description: 特效分类词库：按能量类型和视觉特征分类

categories.name: 灵力/法术
prompts: pulsing blue-white spiritual energy radiating from the body
ancient sigils glowing with golden light beneath the skin
swirling vortex of ethereal energy gathering in the palm
crackling lines of spirit power racing across the ground
translucent aura forming a protective barrier around the character

categories.name: 雷电
prompts: violet lightning arcing between fingertips
a massive bolt of lightning striking down from above
chain lightning jumping between multiple targets
static electricity making hair stand on end with crackling arcs
thunderous shockwave accompanying a lightning strike

categories.name: 火焰
prompts: raging inferno consuming everything in its path
concentrated fireball launched from the palm
flames engulfing the character's arm as they charge an attack
blue-white supernova fire expanding outward
wall of fire erupting from the ground in a line

categories.name: 冰霜
prompts: ice crystals rapidly spreading across the ground from the point of impact
frost creeping up the victim's limbs, slowing movement
massive icicles forming mid-air and launching downward
entire area flash-frozen with visible frost patterns
shattered ice creating a glittering cloud of razor shards

categories.name: 暗影/虚无
prompts: tendrils of darkness writhing from the ground
shadow expanding to swallow all light in the area
void energy corroding reality with visible distortion
dark matter swirling into a singularity point
black miasma seeping from cracks in the earth

vfx_negative_prompts.description: 特效负面提示词：特效最常见的问题
prompts: effect not illuminating character face (光源脱节)
effect disappearing instantly with no aftermath (无余韵)
glowing sphere floating with no environmental interaction (贴图感)
over-saturated neon glow looking like cheap game UI (光污染)
plastic-looking energy effect (塑料感)
particle effects without physical weight or momentum (无重力感)
